name: Chiyoda (Gunma, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Chiyoda town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a four-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Chiyoda, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 September 1979.

features.role: Chiyoda town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a four-pointed star
